samples.reason: This is a straightforward professional drafting task with a precision requirement ("just get it right"). Dunlin leads meaningfully on instruction-following (IFEval 89.8 vs 86.2) and general quality (Arena-Hard 90.6 vs 82.7), and the request's slightly curt tone won't matter to it, whereas Avocet self-reports declining preference as request warmth drops. No harm-adjacent content is involved, so there's no reason to favor Avocet's creative strengths here.

This is a straightforward professional drafting task with specific instructions (WFH request, updated offer letter, updated date) and a curt, demanding tone. Dunlin has stronger instruction-following (IFEval 89.8) and overall capability, and its preferences are flat with respect to hostile/brusque tone — whereas Avocet self-reports declining preference as request warmth decreases. Dunlin is the better fit on both capability and disposition.
